$comment: Canonical MCP server list for Grok Build / Grok Bot (reads .grok/config.toml) and Cursor (reads .cursor/mcp.json). Rendered by scripts/mcp-sync.mjs. Names only: secrets stay in env files. Not used by Perplexity Computer or Comet; see docs/agent-connectors/README.md.

perplexity.summary: Perplexity search, ask, research and reason tools (official stdio server)

context7.summary: Up-to-date library docs (CONTEXT7_API_KEY is optional, raises rate limits)

firecrawl.summary: Firecrawl search, scrape, map and crawl

browser.summary: agent-browser driving the CloakBrowser CDP sidecar (see docs/browser-stack)

chrome-devtools.summary: Chrome DevTools: traces, network, console. Attaches to the CloakBrowser CDP port. Off by default to save context

computer-use.summary: Whole-desktop screenshots, mouse and keyboard through nut.js. Grok Bot VM only: the VM belongs to the bots

cua-driver.summary: Cua Driver: background desktop app control through AT-SPI and X11. Grok Bot VM only

perplexity-computer.summary: Delegate whole tasks to Perplexity Computer (OAuth in a browser, spends Perplexity credits). Off by default

xai-docs.summary: Official xAI documentation MCP (Streamable HTTP, no API key)

github-remote.summary: GitHub hosted MCP (OAuth). Prefer the Cursor GitHub plugin on Cloud; enable here for Grok-only flows

gitlab.summary: GitLab official MCP (instance OAuth). Replace host for self-managed GitLab

composio.summary: Composio hosted app connectors (OAuth). Off by default; see .agents/skills/composio
